Create EXACTLY TWELVE COMPLETE Fabius Réquiem NORMAL figures in THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS on a tall portrait truly transparent RGBA canvas. Do NOT modify any reference sheet. Draw only NEW NORTH-EAST and EAST walking poses. Reference1 is the authoritative EAST/right-profile costume/body/neutral silver katana orientation (top row). Reference2 gives the NORTH-EAST/three-quarter-back appearance (bottom row). Reference3 is the HUMAN-APPROVED Normal walking identity/style/cadence. Reference4 is the technically accepted new NW/N full-figure walking style/scale; it is only a reference, no mirrored or rotated copies.
FIRST SIX figures (rows1-2, left-to-right) form WALK NORTHEAST: heading diagonally UP-RIGHT45degrees. Show three-quarter BACKS, with back of skull/short brown hair/nape, shoulders, trunk, hip, legs and boots all pointing UP-RIGHT together. Only a slim ear/side-jaw edge may show on the right; NO front-facing eyes, no owl neck or face looking toward viewer. Rear coat/belt/posterior shoulder line dominates. LAST SIX figures (rows3-4) form WALK EAST: true RIGHT PROFILE. Nose, chest and boots point directly RIGHT, one visible dark-red eye only, far shoulder partially occluded. Head and torso must turn coherently. No front/SE body substituted for trueE. Draw genuine directions, do not flip/mirror asymmetric katana hand or belt chain, do not rotate a flat sprite.
For EACH direction, SIX real distinct phases of an in-place WALK (400ms loop). Phase0 NEAR leg extends FORWARD along UP-RIGHT forNE, or RIGHT forE; far leg extends BACK. Phase1 near leg supports and far knee swings forward. Phase2 FAR boot passes underhip ahead of nearboot. Phase3 FAR leg extends long FORWARD while NEAR leg extends BACK: clearly the OPPOSITE stride ofphase0. For EAST phase3 the foreground/near boot is the LEFTMOST TRAILING boot on screenLEFT, far boot is the RIGHTMOST LEADING boot on screenRIGHT. Phase4 far supports, near knee bends behindLEFT and swingsforward. Phase5 nearfoot passes beneathhip into phase0. Both legs MUST exchange roles; no sameboot leading throughout, no repeated pose shifted oncanvas. Make knee/boot exchange visible with modest split of coat tails. Natural counterbalanced free-arm swing, controlled lowered sword, restrained headbob and coatmotion; ordinarywalking, not running/lunging/jumping. Keep body/skullsize constant across all12.
Match approved Fabius identity/proportions EXACTLY: youthful-adult approved anatomy, same height/build/head-to-bodyratio; natural SHORT dark brown layered haircut and canonical volume/nape, clean warm peach skin, clearly visible DARK-RED iris #C40814/shadow#5A0000 only wherevisible. Black longcoat with restrained burgundy lining, modest physical redstud/seam accents, blacktrousers/gloves/strappedboots, silverbeltchain. No infant anatomy, hairgrowth, transformedred/violet/silverhair, glowingblade, crystals/largegauntlets, aura or tintedskin. Normal neutral SILVER curved steel katana with graphite/blackhilt ALWAYS held in anatomical RIGHT hand according to the directionalreferences. Left handfree. Do not swap weaponhands when changing views. Keep lowered blade whole and readable atnatural walkingangle, not below theboot baseline, no actiontrail.
Every sprite includes ENTIRE hair/head/body/bothhands/coat/legs/boots/hilt/blade-tip with generous transparent margin allaround, fully contained in its owncell. No overlap or croppedtips. Crisp squarepixelclusters, deliberate darkoutline and palette/lighting consistent withreferences, no painterlyblur/smoothing. NO text/numbers/arrows/labels/grid/frame/floor/shadow/backgroundgradient/checkerboardpixels. ActualtransparentRGBA. New WHOLE drawings only: never transplant anatomical pieces or construct characters from parts. Existing approved S/SW/W/NW/N sheets remain unchanged.
